metadata.title: The Well-Tempered clAIvier
metadata.subtitle: Prelude IV in C-sharp minor - v5 (hand-authored, sixteenth-note broken-chord accompaniment, caesura as arrival + pause, shortened return)

markers.label: Caesura: arrival, then pause over the pedal

notes: A1 i: U states M; L broken C#m triads (C#-G#-E-G#), turning to V on beat 3
A2 i6-ii6-V: U descends; L broken chords on E, F#m, G#
A3 i6-IV(A)-vii: M again; L rises through A major to D#dim
A4 i-IV: cadence-like; L keeps 16ths (B3 passing tone inside the C#m figure)
A5 HAND SWITCH: L states M (tenor); U plays 16ths: C#m, A major, G#dim/V
A6 iv: M up a fourth; L F#m, then D (iv6)
A7 V: M on the dominant with leading tone; L G#7 -> D#dim
A8 i, then B7 (V of E) pivot into E major
B9 I: M in E major; L broken E triads, then A (IV)
B10 HAND SWITCH: L states M in E (tenor); U 16ths: E, B, E6/4
B11 V7: M on B; L B7 arpeggios, 3rd up
B12 I -> vi: L broken E, then C#m under G#5
B13 I-IV-V7: L broken chords E, A, B7
B14 V7-vi-I7: D natural (7th of E7) anticipates A major
C15 A major (bVI): sequence 1; L A major arpeggios, E7-ish beat 3
C16 HAND SWITCH, sequence 2: L states M in F#m; U 16ths F#m7, F#m, E
C17 D major (Neapolitan 6/3): sequence 3; L D6/3, Bm7-ish, A7/E
C18 A7 respelled: German 6th (A C# E F##); L carries the G (= F##) up to the V pedal
C19 V pedal; M in augmentation (1); L G#7 arpeggios keep the pedal pulsing
C20 augmentation (2); L arpeggio climbs through G#7 toward the arrival
C21 CAESURA a: ARRIVAL - the dominant seventh F#5 lands over the G# pedal and is HELD (fermata-like); the pedal is attacked once
C22 CAESURA b: RHETORICAL PAUSE - upper hand silent, pedal alone sounding; a four-sixteenth pickup leads into the drop
C23 DROP: M as continuous sixteenths in U; L G#7 pedal arpeggios
C24 flurry rises; L V - i - iv
C25 hemiola begins: L 16ths in groups of 8 (3 x 8 over two bars of 3/4)
C26 hemiola; ties the A5 into the approach
C27 V7 approach (A over the dominant)
D28 i: return; L now falls (G#-E-C#) instead of rising
D29 V: M on the dominant; L G#7/B# first inversion arpeggios
D30 HAND SWITCH: L states M in the middle register; U plays 16ths above
D31 Neapolitan (D): U long notes; L D major arpeggios
D32 French 6th (A C# D# F##); L spells the whole chord as an arpeggio
D33 i 6/4 over the G# bass
D34 i: M with rising tail; L moves to iv at the end
D35 DESCENDING CHROMATIC BASS A-G#-G-F#-F-E (implied in L on every 2nd sixteenth), pivot E-D-C# above it
D36 V: L G#7 rising arpeggios
D37 i
D38 tail G#-F#-E-D#; L i6 then V6/5
D39 end: final tonic (dramatic exception: octave C# below a held C#5)
